preview.text: Malaysia and Saudi Arabia meet in a T20 match at Bayuemas Oval, having previously played 5 recorded T20 meetings where Malaysia won 3 and Saudi Arabia won 2. Malaysia won the toss and chose to bat first on a ground where the usual first-innings score in the 85 recorded T20 matches is 118. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 71 per cent chance of rain and about 27 degrees.

summary.text: Saudi Arabia won this match by 3 wkts after scoring 139-7 in their innings, led by Abdul Wahid with 67 off 44 balls against Virandeep Singh, who took 3 for 15. MLY had earlier posted 137-2 with Virandeep Singh as their top scorer on 61 off 53 balls, while Ishtiaq Ahmad took 1 for 18.
